info.title: KR Homebase API
info.description: Generated from the route definitions. Do not edit by hand; run `pnpm openapi`.

get.summary: Report that the API Worker is running and which version answered.
get.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: None.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: INTERNAL_ERROR.

get.summary: Return the public settings the login card needs.
get.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: None.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: INTERNAL_ERROR.

turnstileRequired.description: True when the person must pass the Cloudflare human check before signing in.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Public Cloudflare Turnstile site key, or null when the check is switched off.

firmName.description: Firm name shown on the login card.

post.summary: Check the Cloudflare human-check token and remember a pass for five minutes.
post.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: Calls Cloudflare Turnstile siteverify; Sets the kr_turnstile_verified cookie.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED, TURNSTILE_VALIDATION_FAILED, TURNSTILE_UNAVAILABLE, AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED, INTERNAL_ERROR.

token.description: The one-time token the Turnstile widget gave the browser.

verified.description: Always true; a failed check is an error reply.

hostname.description: Host name Cloudflare saw the widget on.

action.description: Action label the widget was rendered with.

422.description: The request did not match the contract (VALIDATION_FAILED).

get.summary: Send the browser to Google to sign in.
get.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: Sets the OAuth state and nonce cookies; Clears the Turnstile pass cookie.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: INTERNAL_ERROR.

302.description: Redirect to Google, or to /login?auth_error=<code> when sign-in cannot start.

get.summary: Finish Google sign-in: check the answer, admit the person and open a session.
get.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: Calls Google (token exchange and signing keys); Calls the CRUD Worker: reads user, user_sso_identity, user_invite; writes individual, individual_contact_method, user, user_sso_identity, user_invite, employee, kr_session, kr_homebase_initialization; Sets the session cookie.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED, INTERNAL_ERROR.

schema.description: The state value Google sends back.

parameters.description: The state value Google sends back.
parameters.name: state

schema.description: Google error code when the person declined or Google refused.

parameters.description: Google error code when the person declined or Google refused.
parameters.name: error

302.description: Redirect to / when signed in, or to /login?auth_error=<code>.

422.description: The request did not match the contract (VALIDATION_FAILED).

get.summary: Return the signed-in person for the current session cookie.
get.description:
Any signed-in user.

Side effects: Updates last_seen_at on the session through the Session Worker.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, SESSION_VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR.

displayName.description: Name to show for the person.

role.description: Role stored on the user account.

firmName.description: Firm name for the account block.

avatarInitials.description: Two to four letters for the avatar circle.

mfaVerified.description: True when a second step was already satisfied.

503.description: The session check is not available (SESSION_VALIDATION_UNAVAILABLE).

delete.summary: Log out: clear the session cookie and close the session.
delete.description:
Public (no sign-in).

Side effects: Clears the session cookie; Marks the kr_session row revoked through the CRUD Worker (best effort).

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: INTERNAL_ERROR.

loggedOut.description: Always true. The cookie is cleared and the session is closed when it could be found.

get.summary: List every registered outside tool, for the super admin.
get.description:
Roles: super_admin.

Side effects: None.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR.

clientId.description: The tool client id given at registration, for example krt_Ab12Cd34Ef56Gh78Ij90Kl12. Public, not a secret.

label.description: Words shown in the left menu.

description.description: One-line purpose, shown as the menu tooltip.

icon.description: Icon drawn beside the tool in the left menu.

menuOrder.description: Position among the outside tools in the menu; lower comes first.

origin.description: Origin of the tool screen (scheme, host and port), taken from entryUrl.

entryUrl.description: Full address of the tool screen.

allowedRoles.description: Roles that see the tool in the menu and may use it.

items.description: A permission granted to an outside tool, in the form <area>:<read|write>.

status.description: active: shown and allowed to call the API. disabled: hidden, and every call is refused at once.

serverAccessEnabled.description: True when the tool server may get access tokens (path B).

serverIpAllowlist.description: When not empty, the only addresses the tool server may call from.

hasSecret.description: True when a client secret exists. The secret itself is shown only once, when it is made.

secretCreatedAt.description: When the current client secret was made (ISO time), or null.

previousSecretValidUntil.description: Until when the secret replaced last still works (ISO time), or null.

createdAt.description: When the tool was registered (ISO time).

updatedAt.description: When the registration last changed (ISO time).

tools.description: Every registered tool, in menu order.

503.description: The tools tables cannot be reached (TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE).

delete.summary: Remove an outside tool and end its access tokens. Its audit rows are kept.
delete.description:
Roles: super_admin.

Side effects: Deletes workspace_tool and its workspace_tool_token rows; Writes workspace_tool_audit.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED, UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, TOOL_NOT_FOUND, TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR.

422.description: The request did not match the contract (VALIDATION_FAILED).

post.summary: Make a new client secret for an outside tool; the old one may keep working for a short overlap.
post.description:
Roles: super_admin.

Side effects: Writes workspace_tool (secret hashes); Deletes workspace_tool_token rows when the overlap is 0; Writes workspace_tool_audit.

Outside tools: not allowed.

Error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED, UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, TOOL_NOT_FOUND, TOOL_SERVER_ACCESS_OFF, TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE, INTERNAL_ERROR.

keepPreviousForHours.description: Hours the old secret keeps working (0 to 72). 0 ends it at once.

200.description: The new secret, in this reply only.

clientSecret.description: The new client secret, shown only in this reply.

previousSecretValidUntil.description: Until when the old secret still works (ISO time), or null when it ended at once.
